SERVICES AGREEMENT

This Agreement is made on 1 July 2025 between Noble & Sons Ltd, a company registered in England (No. 08841207), whose registered office is at 14 Fenwick Yard, London EC2M 4QP (the "Provider"), and Calder Precision Works GmbH, Stuttgart, Germany (the "Client").

1. Scope
The Provider shall deliver the services described in Schedule A.

2. Term
The initial term is twelve (12) months from the Effective Date.

3. Fees and payment

Invoices are issued monthly and payable within thirty (30) days.

4. Confidentiality

Each party shall keep the other's confidential information secret and shall use it solely for the purposes of this Agreement.

5. Governing law

This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

Signed for the Provider: A. Noble, Director

Signed for the Client: M. Keller, Managing Director
